title: Mechanistic Insights into How the Single Point Mutation Change the Autoantibody Repertoire.
authors: Ni, Zhong; Song, Fangyuan; Zhou, Huimin; Xu, Ying; Wang, Zhiguo; Chen, Dongfeng
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟和实验验证，解析了单点突变F33Y如何通过削弱pi-pi堆积作用导致抗DNA抗体丧失ssDNA结合能力，属于蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，方法上采用MD模拟，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但对理解蛋白-DNA界面动态结合机理具有方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: A recent study showed that just one point mutation F33 to Y in the complementarity-determining region 1 of heavy chain (H-CDR1) could lead to the auto-antibody losing its DNA binding ability. However, the potential molecular mechanisms have not been well elucidated. In this study, we investigated how the antibody lost the DNA binding ability caused by mutation F33 to Y in the H-CDR1. We found that the electrostatic force was not the primary driving force for the interaction between anti-DNA antibodies and the antigen single strand DNA (ssDNA), and that the H-CDR2 largely contributed to the binding of antigen ssDNA, even larger than H-CDR1. The H-F33Y mutation could increase the hydrogen-bond interaction but impair the pi-pi stacking interaction between the antibody and ssDNA. We further found that F33(H), W98(H) and Y95(L) in the wiletype antibody could form the stable pi-pi stacking interaction with the nucleotide bases of ssDNA. However, the Y33 in mutant could not form the parallel sandwich pi-pi stacking interaction with the ssDNA. To further confirm the importance of pi-pi stacking, the wildtype antibody and the mutants (F33Y(H), F33A(H), W98A(H) and Y95A(L)) were experimentally expressed in CHO cells and purified, and the results from ELISA clearly showed that all the mutants lost the ssDNA binding ability. Taken together, our findings may not only deepen the understanding of the underlying interaction mechanism between autoantibody and antigen, but also broad implications in the field of antibody engineer.
abstract_zh: 近期一项研究表明，重链互补决定区1（H-CDR1）中的单一氨基酸点突变F33至Y即可导致自身抗体失去DNA结合能力。然而，其潜在的分子机制尚未得到充分阐明。本研究探讨了H-CDR1中F33至Y突变导致抗体失去DNA结合能力的原因。我们发现，静电作用力并非抗DNA抗体与抗原单链DNA（ssDNA）相互作用的主要驱动力，且H-CDR2对ssDNA抗原结合的贡献大于H-CDR1。H-F33Y突变增强了氢键相互作用，但削弱了抗体与ssDNA之间的π-π堆积作用。进一步研究发现，野生型抗体中的F33(H)、W98(H)和Y95(L)能与ssDNA的核苷酸碱基形成稳定的π-π堆积作用，而突变体中的Y33则无法与ssDNA形成平行的夹心式π-π堆积作用。为验证π-π堆积的重要性，我们在CHO细胞中实验性表达并纯化了野生型抗体及突变体（F33Y(H)、F33A(H)、W98A(H)和Y95A(L)），ELISA结果清晰显示所有突变体均丧失了ssDNA结合能力。综上，我们的发现不仅加深了对自身抗体与抗原相互作用机制的理解，也对抗体工程领域具有广泛启示意义。
